Container.Name: ComicFlex
Container.Overview: ComicFlex is a comics, manga and digital book server with a web reader and OPDS support (fork of Stump, written in Rust). First run walks the setup wizard: create the admin account, then one library per folder.
Container.Description:
ComicFlex serves a comics and manga library over a web reader, OPDS v1.2/v2.0 and native KOReader sync. It is a fork of [Stump](https://github.com/stumpapp/stump) that carries reader fixes not yet upstream: panel auto-zoom that no longer slices into needless pan stops, ACBF parsing that keeps self-closed cover pages, and orphan balloons that no longer jump the reading order.
### Volumes
- `/data` = the library tree, **read-only**. One `<Config>` path per root folder; each LMS naming convention below it is one library in the app. - `/config` = `Stump.toml`, `stump.db` (users, libraries, reading progress, thumbnails, bookmarks) and the logs. This is the whole state; back it up.
### Permissions
The entrypoint honours `PUID`/`PGID` (`99`/`100` by default), fixes the ownership of `/config` and then drops privileges to that user — so do **not** add `--user` to `<ExtraParams>`, or the entrypoint cannot fix ownership at all.
### Notes
`/data` stays read-only on purpose: the app keeps its metadata in `/config`, and a server bug must not be able to touch the library. The entrypoint prints a harmless "chown: /data: Read-only file system" line on start because it tries to set the mount-point owner.
Container.Changes: First release. Bridge network on port 10801, appdata in /mnt/cache/appdata/comicflex, library read-only from /mnt/user/library, runs as 99:100 through PUID/PGID.

Config.Description: HTTP port of the web interface and the GraphQL API.

Config.Description: Persistent data: Stump.toml, stump.db (libraries, users, progress), thumbnails and logs.

Config.Description: Comics/library tree, read-only. Add one path per library root.

Config.Description: User ID the server runs as. Unraid default: 99 (nobody).

Config.Description: Group ID the server runs as. Unraid default: 100 (users).
